Tung Ho Steel Enterprise Corp Appoints New Chief Financial Officer

Tung Ho Steel Enterprise Corp, a leading steel manufacturer in Taiwan, has named Linda Chen as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. The appointment was announced following a board meeting at the company’s Taipei headquarters earlier this week.

Chen, who previously served as Deputy CFO at Eastern Alloy Industries, brings over two decades of experience in financial management and strategic planning in Taiwan’s heavy industry sector. She is expected to help steer Tung Ho Steel Enterprise Corp through a period of stable domestic demand and rising international competition.

In a statement, Tung Ho Steel Enterprise Corp Chairman James Wu said, “We are delighted to welcome Linda to our executive team. Her proven track record in managing complex financial operations will be instrumental as we continue to invest in capacity upgrades and sustainable production.”

Analysts say the appointment signals the company’s ongoing commitment to financial discipline and operational efficiency. “Tung Ho Steel has maintained a solid balance sheet despite fluctuating steel prices over the past year,” noted Kelly Huang, senior analyst at Formosa Securities Research. “A leadership refresh at the financial helm is a prudent move as the company navigates evolving market dynamics.”

According to the Taiwan Steel Industry Association, domestic crude steel production grew by 3.2% in the first quarter of 2024, buoyed by robust construction and infrastructure activity. Tung Ho Steel Enterprise Corp reported NT$18.5 billion in revenues for the same period, reflecting its strong market position.

Chen will oversee financial reporting, risk management, and capital allocation as part of her new role.
